comment: A resize or a scale change fits the dockers again and forks nothing. On a 3840 by 2160 panel in the shipped default, the interface scale goes from 1 to 2 and back, Tab is pressed twice and the second row is turned on and off, and then the same three scales on a 1280 by 1024 panel. The state's docker_layout says default at every step and the windows array holds each docker's rectangle. Last, one edit forks the default and the corner notice names the fork, which is then deleted.
01, the 4K panel at scale 1: the default fitted to it, the right column at its distance from the right edge.
02, the 4K panel at scale 2: the default fitted to a host of 1920 by 1080, which is the file as written, every title below the bar and the menus from Layer to Help clear.
03, back at scale 1 every docker is where 01 had it, and the layout is still default.
04, Tab twice and the second row on: every title below the taller bar, and still default.
05, the second row off again: every docker where 01 had it, and still default.
06, the 1280 by 1024 panel at scale 1, the default fitted to it.
07, at scale 2 the host is 640 by 512: every title below the bar, the dockers at their floors and the menus reachable.
08, back at scale 1 every docker is where 06 had it, and the layout is still default.
09, one edit forks the default, and the corner notice names Default (Custom), the first fork of the session.
